method: Five rotating, mirrored six-leg cycles. Each leg uses a fresh process per prompt. Both engines greedy, FP16 KV, context 8192, speculation disabled. Prompt lengths 32 and 1024 from the same README token file. Lean --gen 16 performs 16 decode forwards and returns the first 16 IDs; Basalt --max-new 17 performs 16 decode forwards and returns 17 IDs including the prefill prediction. Recorded Basalt phases have whole-millisecond resolution. Process peak VRAM sampled via NVML every ~4 ms. Mean elapsed phases include only complete cycles.

quality_100_chunks.corpus: WikiText 100 chunks, 512 tokens, 25,500 teacher-forced positions. Same BF16 oracle and scoring formula. See Inkling #35 and the external-logit replay report.

llama_bf16.method: ABBA x5, PRO 5000, one sequence, FP16 KV, 8,192 context, greedy. Each fresh process scores five fixed requests. Discard first request for timing; check all 32 predicted IDs each time (forced continuation). NVML per-PID VRAM polling at 4 ms target.
